payload.title: a longer home at run time than at install
payload.body: Install weighs each claude main-session skill against the home it installs under. If the same files are later reached through a longer home path, a skill near the 10,000-character hook cap (plan is 47 under with a short home) can exceed it and arrive as Claude's 2 KB preview with no warning. Shrinking plan below the cap with margin, or a run-time check in the hook, would close it.
